notes: First session on the post-patch build (Ash Cloak at 2, Bellows no longer self-discards). With Wildfire restricted, games went the distance — both went past round 5.

card_notes.note: At cost 2 it's a real decision instead of an auto-play. Good change.
Keeping Bellows in play opens a slow-burn economy line nobody had explored. Two distinct archetypes now.
Quietly the best card now? Watch steal tempo over next sessions.

decisions.action: Hold all changes; gather 3 more sessions on this build
